title: Vector Fourier support
statement: For $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, its vector Fourier support is the set of vectors $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ for which the vector Fourier coefficient $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is nonzero.
